jess-prod: quick follow-up from the ACME Dedicated outage — i sketched a remediation plan, collecting owners/timelines below. main issues: intermittent vpc peering flaps + on-prem NAT exhaustion that prevented isolation failover.

omar-sre: thanks. can we split into 3 items: (A) vpc peering stability, (B) on-prem NAT capacity + alerts, (C) isolation fallback hardening?

carmen-eng: assigning A to infra-networking (me), B to onprem-support (will pair w/ cust infra team), C to runtime (marshall). i'll create tickets now.

postmortem-bot: postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/ACME-2026-03-15 (PM-742)

carmen-eng: Action A (VPC peering): owner=jess-prod/backstop=carmen-eng, ETA=2026-03-31. deliverables: peering health checks, automated peering reconnection handler, and deployment runbook. ticket: INF-3421.

jess-prod: plan for A: add BGP keepalive monitor + 30s probe, add alert when >3 flaps in 10m. i'll push config to staging today, can we validate by EOD Tue? :thumbsup:

omar-sre: for B (NAT capacity): owner=omar-sre, ETA=2026-04-05. deliverables: synthetic traffic test, capacity threshold alert, and a scripted failover test with cust onprem team. ticket: ONPREM-78.

omar-sre: quick check command i'll use for NAT counters:
```
sudo ss -natp | grep ESTAB
# and netstat -s | grep establish
```

amy-revops: i'll coordinate cust change window for the scripted failover test, prefer Wed morning. adding to cust runbook.

carmen-eng: for C (isolation fallback): owner=marshall-runtime (cc: jess-prod), ETA=2026-04-07. deliverables: stricter pre-failover sanity checks, fallback mask to a lower-capacity model group, and a canary test harness. ticket: RUNTIME-619.

jess-prod: note — we observed one case where fallback attempted to route to an onprem replica that was in maintenance. adding pre-check to avoid replicas in maintenance state.

omar-sre: recurring pattern: two customers in the last quarter had peering flaps coupled w/ nat pressure. propose a quarterly audit for Dedicated customers with onprem peering. owner=amy-revops, ETA=2026-04-15.

amy-revops: ack, will draft audit checklist (peering configs, keepalive policies, nat sizing, runbook gaps).

carmen-eng: i've created the three tickets and linked them in the PM doc. i'm also adding a follow-up review meeting on 2026-04-10 to confirm remediation closure.

jess-prod: final ask — please add required QA steps in each ticket (staging validation, chaos test, customer window). i'll review tomorrow. (reacted :white_check_mark:)

postmortem-bot: reminder scheduled: PM-742 follow-up meeting on 2026-04-10 16:00 UTC.

omar-sre: thanks all. i'll update ONPREM-78 with the test plan and post results here.

jess-prod: closing loop: if anyone hits blockers ping me directly so we can escalate to infra leadership.
